description: Siting Lab is the NLR resource for data on where renewable energy facilities can be sited in the United States, hosted on the Open Energy Data Initiative. Contents: county-level ordinances (setbacks from property lines, buildings, roads and water, height limits, lot size limits, bans and moratoriums), high-resolution radar line-of-sight data, supply curve data to estimate technical potential with composite siting criteria, hourly capacity factor profiles and cost analyses, for land-based wind, offshore wind, solar PV and geothermal. The solar ordinance database was compiled from a locality-by-locality review of zoning ordinances at state, county, township and city level with citations per ordinance. Producer: NLR geospatial science, with the Siting Lab GitHub holding tutorials for use with the reV model. Coverage: United States, with land-based and offshore wind supply curves for the contiguous states. Format and access: datasets and downloads through data.openei.org/siting_lab (counts did not render from the cloud). Licence: OEDI content is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 unless otherwise noted. Caveats: ordinances change and coverage differs by locality. Simulation uses: siting constraint inputs for capacity expansion and transmission planning models. Related records: the Open Energy Data Initiative record and NLR's pumped storage and geothermal supply curve records.
